messages:
Sam Rivera: Quick flag from candidate feedback: recurring issue where interview invites show 'TBD_LINK' or no join URL. Also several scorecards returned with 'unsure' for role-fit and no comments.

Priya Nair: Thanks. Was this after the ATS template update on Monday? I saw a couple of webhook errors in the pipeline.

Evan Brooks: Yep. I pulled one webhook: `{"candidate":"R-998", "slots":[], "meeting_url":null}`. Renderer treats empty slots as omit, which then drops meeting_url.

RecruiterBot: [automated] ATS -> calendar: webhook failed (422) for R-998.

Olivia Park: Proposed fixes: 1) make meeting_url fallback to company default join URL if missing, 2) make scorecard fields 'role fit' and 'recommendation' required, 3) run a 20-min calibration for interviewers tomorrow.

Sam Rivera: Sounds good. Evan can you add server-side guard so empty slot arrays don't remove meeting_url? Priya, can you update the ATS template to include a checklist reminding interviewers to open the scorecard?

Evan Brooks: On it. Will open a PR and add log tag `invite_render_missing_slots`. ETA: EOD.

Priya Nair: I'll add the checklist and create a 20-min calibration invite for tomorrow 11am PT.

Sam Rivera: Thanks all 44d will follow up after PR and calibration.
